newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai Oct automobile sales rise 5.8 pct - Toyota.
newsitem.headline: Thai Oct automobile sales rise 5.8 pct - Toyota.

text.p: Sales of cars and commercial vehicles in Thailand rose 5.8 percent in October to 47,860 units from 45,226 in the same month last year, Toyota Motors (Thailand) said on Monday.

Higher automobile sales should continue in the last two months of the year in anticipation of a clearer political climate following Sunday's election and the end of the monsoon season, Toyota said in a statement.

Cumulative vehicle sales in the first ten months of 1996 rose 5.2 percent to 482,881 from 458,910 in the same period last year, Toyota said. Toyota remained the top seller of vehicles in October with a 29.4 percent market share on sales of 14,056 units, up from 14,023 in the year-earlier month, it said.
Isuzu was second with 9,566 units sold for a 20 percent market share, compared with 10,424 units a year ago.
Total passenger-car sales in the month rose 29.2 percent to 14,633 from 11,328 a year earlier.

Toyota was the biggest seller of passenger cars in October, selling 3,945 units for a 27 percent market share, against 3,893 in October last year. Honda came in second with 3,391 cars sold in the month, or 23.2 percent of the market, compared with 1,496 in the same month the previous year, it said.
